channel.title: Milad Ebrahimi — Ideas
channel.description: Notes on operations, systems, and where AI actually helps.

item.title: Productivity Is Not About Doing More — It's About Designing Better Work
item.description: Better productivity starts when work becomes visible, priorities become clear, and the system around execution gets simpler.
item.author: Milad Ebrahimi

item.title: AI Won't Transform Your Organization If Your Processes Are Broken
item.description: AI can automate tasks, accelerate decisions, and improve productivity. But it cannot fix an organization that doesn't understand how its work actually happens.
item.author: Milad Ebrahimi

item.title: Why Most Organizations Don't Have an Operations Problem — They Have a Systems Problem
item.description: When processes depend on people, organizations eventually become difficult to scale. The real challenge is designing a system that makes execution visible, repeatable, and accountable.
item.author: Milad Ebrahimi
